name: semen-connect
description: Transport Management System for Arba Minch hub

scripts.postinstall: npm run install-all && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently "set PORT=4003&& npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
